provenance.scene: ParityReference toolbar-ellipsis, native controls toolbar Menu over black (iPhone 17 Pro Max Simulator, iOS 27.0)
provenance.model: One damped spring per axis, each a displacement from 1 to 0: released after `delay` ms with initial velocity `velocity` (per second; negative moves toward the target), natural frequency `omega` (rad/s), damping ratio `zeta`. centerX, centerY, width and height are the travelling member, normalized between the trigger (0) and the panel (1).
provenance.open: ms after the trigger release +43 ms. Fitted to the native outline bounds (union of trigger and drop), RMS 0.018-0.041 per axis (native measurements).
provenance.close: ms after the close tap +41 ms (our measured tap-to-motion latency, so frames line up with native's in tap time). The four axes and closeHead are fitted together so the outline of our two-member field overlaps native's outline frame by frame (mean IoU 0.914 against a 0.90 ceiling for this measure; native measurements fit). On close the body's width and height are shares of the panel that collapse to nothing inside the button, and its centre travels to the button's current centre.
provenance.closeHead: The re-formed button's size, 0 to 1 (1 - displacement).
provenance.closeButton: The re-formed button's centre: home + from * displacement * (panel centre - home) per axis. One spring fits both axes of the native dots' tracked centre to 0.14 pt RMS (native measurements fit): it forms 8.9 pt short of home in x and 10 pt past it in y, rises to 13.5 pt past, and is home by about +530 ms of the tap.
